scenarios.title: A custodian proposes, an administrator approves, then it runs
scenarios.say: A custodian's action needs approval from a tenant administrator before it executes; an administrator's own action runs at once, audited with the acting user. Self-approval, another custodian approving, approving too early and an unsupported delete are refused, and the audit log names the acting user each time.

steps.say: maya.chen proposes quarantining ag-bedrock-02, a reconciler that holds an administrator grant.
maya.chen tries to approve their own proposal: refused.
steps.detail: nobody approves their own proposal

steps.say: omar.reyes, another custodian, tries to approve it: only a tenant administrator can.
steps.detail: every custodian action needs approval from a tenant administrator

steps.say: Running a proposal that is not yet approved is refused.
steps.detail: an administrator must approve the proposal before it runs

steps.say: priya.nair approves the quarantine.
maya.chen executes it. The agent's identity is detached and its administrator-privilege finding no longer applies.
lee.park tries to approve it again: it is already decided.
steps.detail: that proposal is already decided

steps.say: priya.nair is an administrator: their own retag runs immediately, with no second approval, and is audited with their name.
priya.nair proposes deleting a Databricks agent. The deck says delete is in development there, so it is refused.
steps.detail: delete is not supported on this source (the deck says Databricks is "in development")

scenarios.title: Agents inside your own network
scenarios.say: A tenant that has not enabled Private network cannot add a connection. Enable it, add a connection whose scanner runs in an AWS account, find that Enabled is fixed once added, let the connector poll outbound, and the next sync discovers the private agents, each carrying where the scanner runs.

steps.say: A first sync: the agents in the private network account are not found.
Adding a connection while the tenant has Private network disabled is refused.
steps.detail: the tenant has not enabled Private network connections

steps.say: priya.nair enables Private network for the tenant.
Add a connection: the Workload Scanner runs in AWS account 000000000009.
Try to switch Enabled off: it is fixed once the connection is added.
steps.detail: Enabled is fixed once the connection is added: add a new connection instead

End the batch job's session.
